aboutText: I'm an Electrical Engineering student at HIT – Holon Institute of Technology, specializing in power systems and renewable energy. I'm drawn to the engineering behind the energy transition: generation, conversion, storage, and the control that keeps it all reliable.

Signal and audio processing is where my engineering curiosity started, and it is still a passion. I've built real-time audio analyzers and DSP tools, and I bring that measurement-and-analysis mindset to power systems work.

I'm still a student and I treat that as an advantage. I learn fast, ask good questions, and document what I build. This site tracks that journey: some projects are polished, others are exploratory, and all of them are hands-on.
contactText: I'm looking for student positions, internships, and projects in power systems and renewable energy. I'm also always happy to talk signals and audio.
